messages:
Jess (Sales): Quick handoff — AstraNova Health signed EULA + SOW yesterday. Committed to Dedicated plan (8x A10) starting 2026-04-01. Renewal note: 12mo, expansion likely in Q4. Main wins: low-latency inference for triage chat, embeddings for search.

Priya (CS): Thanks — assigning to me. Primary CS owner: Priya. Onboarding kickoff scheduled 2026-03-28 10:00 PT. Need product tour + SSO + VPC peering details.

Jess (Sales): Key open items for CS/Eng: 1) SSO via Okta (customer has IdP metadata) 2) Private VPC peering — will need IP ranges + firewall rules 3) Data residency: EU region preferred 4) Ingest pipeline will send batches via SFTP -> model. Also flagged heavy long-context requests (>8k tokens).

Mike (Support): Noted. I'll create support ticket #INC-8342 for infra setup and track SSO. Can whoever has IdP metadata drop it here? @Jess (Sales)

Jess (Sales): Dropped in secure link: https://files.redwood/secure/astranova/okta-metadata.xml :lock: (access: Priya, Mike, Sara)

Sara (Eng): @Priya @Mike heads-up: Dedicated capacity request may require custom kernel selection for long-context. I'll need sample payload shapes + approximate p95 sequence length. Can you add a short sample (anonymized) in the ticket?

Priya (CS): I'll add sample payloads and upload to ticket. Also capturing customer success risks: Renewal risk currently LOW but SSO complexity + VPC timeline could shift to MEDIUM if onboarding delayed >3 weeks.

Priya (CS): Onboarding action items:
- Kickoff 2026-03-28: Priya to run product tour
- SSO: Mike to own setup (INC-8342)
- VPC peering: Mike/Sara to coordinate infra ticket
- Eval plan: 4-week validation period, target latency p95 < 300ms
- Escalation: if infra not ready by 2026-03-31, escalate to Eng leads

Mike (Support): Created ticket https://support.redwood/INC-8342 — added Jess + Priya. Linking to infra request INF-2901 for VPC peering.

Sara (Eng): INF-2901 assigned to me. I'll provision a staging Dedicated cluster in eu-west1, quantify GPU selection. ETA for staging: 5 business days after having IP ranges and access. If they need faster, we can temporarily allow hosted but rate-limit.

Priya (CS): Noted. I'll confirm IP ranges at kickoff and run through the onboarding checklist: provision, SSO, test suite, eval prompts, production cutover.

Jess (Sales): FYI customer has a compliance officer (Marcel) who will require SOC2 evidence and logs forwarding. Priya, can you collect audit scope doc and loop Security?

Priya (CS): Yes — adding Security (sec-team) to the kickoff invite and will capture audit requirements.

Security Bot: Added sec-team to thread. See: https://security.redwood/checklists/soc2

Mike (Support): Quick question for Eng: for long-context >8k tokens, do we want to enable KV cache tweaks or use quantized model variant? @Sara

Sara (Eng): Recommend we enable 8k-context variant and test quantized 4-bit. I'll try both in staging. Note: expect ~15-20% latency delta with quantization.

Priya (CS): Owners and timelines summary:
- Priya (CS): primary owner, kickoff 2026-03-28
- Mike (Support): infra + SSO ticket INC-8342
- Sara (Eng): INF-2901 staging + model variant testing
- Security: collection of SOC2 artifacts
- Jess (Sales): commercial/contact liaison

Priya (CS): I'll send a follow-up doc after kickoff with concrete dates. Anything else?

Jess (Sales): Please flag any blockers early. :thumbsup:

Mike (Support): Acknowledged, will update INC-8342 as items progress.

Sara (Eng): Acknowledged.

Priya (CS): Closing loop — next check-in here after kickoff. :calendar:
